accountable_decision_owner: Cole Lyons, USHSO Public Alpha methodology owner
active_family_basis: No common offered-service taxonomy or six system-bound counts are receipted; claims aggregation, facility inference, marketing-page hand counts, imputation, and fabricated zeroes are prohibited.
active_family_definition: Count of distinct clinical service lines offered by the product system under one preapproved common taxonomy, at the frozen roster boundary and aligned period.
comparison_period_rule: No common period or lag window is approved; AHRQ 2023 identity and CMS RBCS 2025 taxonomy evaluation cannot be substituted for aligned offered-service observations.
comparison_purpose: Determine whether service_line_count can be appended to the common nine-input Scale v1 packet without weakening the frozen roster, period, definition, boundary, or service-taxonomy gates.
